_help: One line per phone-call sprite. Key = path under Talking_Sprites/Characters, no .png. mouth = canvas pixel [x, y] in the middle of the CLOSED mouth. pixel = size of one art pixel (8 Ellie/Alexander, 10 Olly). Optional: scale (size of the opening, 1.0 = the old talking head; default closed mouth width / 32), open_down (true = the opening only grows downwards from the top of the closed mouth), offset ([x, y] canvas pixels to nudge the opening, in the PNG as saved; callers are flipped in the call so +x moves it LEFT on screen), corners ([] or ["up_right", "up_left"]), width (closed mouth width in art pixels). Writes Mouth_1-3 (shut, half, open) and Sad_Mouth_1-3 in the style of the old Ellie talking head. Run: python make_talking_mouths.py --preview
